actual_height_notes: 130px is the opaque silhouette in the 256x320 cell, including a soft ground shadow. Designed body without shadow is about 120px.
scale_notes: 平滑縮放（Lanczos），不要用 nearest 放大。建議小鎮 110px、室內 124px。
playback: Play each row left to right and loop. Head and torso are a frozen bitmap per direction; only feet move. Pass frames translate the same bitmap slightly up. Right-facing frames are a horizontal flip of left.
alignment: Foot-midpoint at x=128, sole at y=296. Authored as a smooth (non-pixel) chibi at ~120px, suggested on-screen draw 110px in town and 124px indoors, with smooth (Lanczos) scaling.
